_doc: Funder facts for grant_proposal: sections, length limits, language, required elements, budget categories and the official guides. Limits follow each funder's guide at the time of writing; check them against the current call before submitting. limit.unit is chars (every character, spaces included), words, zh_chars (a CJK character or punctuation mark counts 1, a run of Latin letters or digits counts 1) or pages (about 500 English words or 800 Chinese characters per page). A require item is matched as a regex against the section's headings (heading) or its whole text (text); level error fails the draft, note only reports. aims_named: every aim's label must appear in the section, at that level.

nsf.name: NSF (U.S. National Science Foundation), standard research proposal

sections.title: Project Summary
sections.guidance: Third person, three statements under the headings Overview, Intellectual Merit and Broader Impacts. Overview: what the project will do and its aims. Intellectual Merit: how it advances knowledge. Broader Impacts: how it benefits society.

sections.title: Project Description
sections.guidance: Objectives and their significance, relation to the state of knowledge, the preliminary results, the research plan aim by aim, evaluation, and a separate section labeled Broader Impacts. If a PI had NSF support in the past five years, Results from Prior NSF Support (the author fills it in).

require.what: Broader Impacts heading (a separate section is required)
require.heading: ^Broader Impacts

sections.title: Data Management and Sharing Plan
sections.guidance: The data, code and other products the project will produce; formats and standards; access and sharing; re-use and redistribution; archiving and preservation.

require.what: how data will be shared or accessed

sections.title: Specific Aims
sections.guidance: One page: the problem and the gap, the long-term goal and the objective of this application, the central hypothesis and the preliminary data that support it, then each aim as 'Aim n: ...' with its hypothesis and approach in two or three sentences, and the expected outcome and impact.

sections.title: Research Strategy
sections.guidance: Three parts under the headings Significance, Innovation and Approach. Approach goes aim by aim: rationale, preliminary results, experimental design, expected outcomes, potential problems and alternative strategies, and benchmarks for success.

erc.name: ERC Frontier Research Grant (Starting / Consolidator / Advanced)

sections.title: Part B1: Extended Synopsis
sections.guidance: A concise presentation of the scientific proposal that the panel reads in step 1: the ground-breaking nature and potential impact, the objectives, and the feasibility of the approach, with key references.

require.what: ground-breaking nature or beyond the state of the art

sections.title: Part B2: Scientific Proposal
sections.guidance: Two parts under the headings 'State-of-the-art and objectives' and 'Methodology': the objectives against the state of the art, why they are ambitious, and the methodology objective by objective, including high-risk/high-gain parts and how risks are handled.

budget: Purchase costs: other goods, works and services

nsfc.name: 国家自然科学基金面上项目

sections.title: 摘要
sections.guidance: 一段话：研究对象和意义、拟解决的关键科学问题、研究内容和方法、预期成果。不写参考文献。

sections.title: （一）立项依据与研究内容 1. 项目的立项依据
sections.guidance: 研究意义，国内外研究现状及发展动态分析，结合科学研究发展趋势论述科学意义；引用文献用给定的键，文末由程序附主要参考文献目录。

sections.title: 2. 研究内容、研究目标及拟解决的关键科学问题
sections.guidance: 分三个小标题：研究内容（逐项写出，每项以“研究内容n”开头）、研究目标、拟解决的关键科学问题。

require.what: 拟解决的关键科学问题小标题
require.heading: 关键科学问题

sections.title: 3. 拟采取的研究方案及可行性分析
sections.guidance: 研究方法、技术路线、实验手段、关键技术，逐个研究内容展开；然后是可行性分析，说明前期结果怎样支持可行性。

require.text: 技术路线|研究方案|研究方法

sections.title: 4. 本项目的特色与创新之处
sections.guidance: 两到四条，每条说清楚与已有工作相比新在哪里。

sections.title: 5. 年度研究计划及预期研究结果
sections.guidance: 按年度（第1年、第2年……）写计划，与时间表一致；然后写预期研究结果，不写具体论文数量以外无据可查的数字。

sections.title: （二）研究基础与工作条件 1. 研究基础
sections.guidance: 与本项目相关的前期研究工作积累和已取得的研究工作成绩，用项目文件里的结果和数字。

nsfc_youth.name: 国家自然科学基金青年科学基金项目

sections.title: Summary
sections.guidance: The problem, the gap, the aims and the expected outcome in one paragraph.

sections.title: Aims
sections.guidance: The goal and the gap, then each aim as 'Aim n: ...' with what it will establish.

sections.title: Background and Significance
sections.guidance: The state of the field with citations, the gap, and why closing it matters.

sections.title: Preliminary Results and Approach
sections.guidance: The preliminary results first, then the plan aim by aim, with risks and alternatives.

sections.title: Expected Outcomes and Impact
sections.guidance: What each aim will deliver and who benefits.
